Manufacturer CQ ratio ranges: 17K/12K/9K Q0 9:1-2.5:1, Q1 11:1-4.5:1, Q3 20:1-8:1, Q5 30:1-10:1; 8K Q0 5:1-2.5:1, Q1 7:1-3:1, Q3 12:1-4:1, Q5 16:1-6:1; 4K Q0 2:1-1.2:1, Q1 3:1-1.3:1, Q3 4:1-1.7:1, Q5 5:1-2:1 (so the 4K family has much higher bpp - always use per-resolution rates).
